insight.title: Why Shortcut Apps Make Your Commute Longer
insight.subtitle: When technology gives everyone the fastest route, the secret shortcut ceases to exist.
insight.notificationHook: Why traffic apps actually slow us down

sections.text: GPS apps promise to save you minutes by routing you through quiet residential side streets. Yet, you often end up bumper-to-bumper on a narrow road that was never meant for heavy traffic.

The paradox is collective behavior. When an app spots an open shortcut, it sends thousands of drivers there simultaneously. Individual optimization destroys the very benefit the app was trying to exploit.

Instead of spreading traffic out, real-time routing synchronizes everyone’s movements. We trade predictable delays on major highways for chaotic gridlock on neighborhood streets, making the entire network slower for everyone.
When everyone has a secret shortcut, nobody gets home faster.
